game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round, giant bats strike the ore lift, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stamina value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ore lift from giant bats in Hidden Spring: keep the stamina meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: stamina drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stamina Climb' (Week 4 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Hidden Spring'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Hidden Spring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while stamina > 0.
